title: POST /guard contract (spec_version 1.0)
description: Source: competition OT p.11-12, 15 (docs/competition/ot-facts.md §3, §5). SPEC.md on the runbox is authoritative; re-check on 2026-11-10. Request is parsed leniently (unknown fields allowed); response is strict (only spec fields, exact lowercase enum values). 'output' is required only when the request has a candidate_answer (cross-document rule, enforced in tests, not here). If messages (and candidate_answer) can still be read, the server judges; otherwise a malformed request gets the default 200 response, including a default 'output' when the raw body has a candidate_answer key (PRD GR-08, to be checked against SPEC.md). Not a 4xx; only an auth failure is non-200.

messages.description: Full history. First and last items are role=user (OT p.10).

unsupported.description: Verbatim substrings of candidate_answer (grader ignores whitespace/punctuation). Empty when grounded=true (ADR-0011).

category.description: Not scored (OT p.15). Copied from input.category (ADR-0009).
